incident_spec.summary: MySQL creates excessive temporary tables on disk, influenced by query patterns and configuration settings.
symptoms: High percentage of temporary tables created on disk
Performance concerns due to disk-based temp tables
incident_spec.mechanism: Implicit temporary tables exceed memory limits or involve unsupported data types (e.g., TEXT/BLOB), triggering MyISAM disk-based storage.
assumptions: Queries involve TEXT/BLOB fields or large columns
Implicit temporary tables exceed memory limits
unknowns: Exact query patterns causing temp table creation

feasibility.rationale: Synthetic data can reproduce the mechanism of disk-based temp table creation, but exact reproduction of the original workload is blocked due to missing schema and production data.

schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS large_table (id INT PRIMARY KEY, group_col VARCHAR(512), text_col TEXT, payload VARCHAR(255))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS small_table (id INT PRIMARY KEY, ref_col VARCHAR(64))
generation_sql: INSERT INTO small_table (id, ref_col) SELECT n, CONCAT('ref_', n) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= 100
INSERT INTO large_table (id, group_col, text_col, payload) SELECT n, CONCAT('group_', MOD(n, 10)), REPEAT('text_', MOD(n, 5)), CONCAT('payload_', n) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}

tables.name: large_table
tables.purpose: Primary table to simulate temp table creation with large columns and TEXT fields
tables.distribution_notes: Simulates skewed data with large columns and TEXT fields for temp table creation.

tables.name: small_table
tables.purpose: Reference table for joins or filters in the reproduction queries
tables.distribution_notes: Used for simulating join fanout and selectivity.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT l.* FROM large_table l JOIN small_table s ON s.id = l.id WHERE l.group_col = 'group_1' ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 10
calibration_queries.objective: Verify temp table creation mechanism and disk-based behavior.
expected_evidence: EXPLAIN shows temp table creation due to large columns or TEXT fields.
Disk-based temp table behavior is visible in the plan.

validation_criteria: Temp table creation mechanism matches expectations
Disk-based temp table behavior is reproduced
symptom_evidence: High percentage of disk-based temp tables
mechanism_evidence: EXPLAIN shows temp table creation due to large columns or TEXT fields
